content: The password of a link is set when the link is created and cannot be shown or changed. To use another password, create a new link.

comment.text: Description text in the settings panel of an existing external link of a private (end-to-end encrypted) room, under the 'Password access' heading, shown in place of the password field. Explains that the password is chosen once at creation, is never displayed and cannot be changed, so another password requires creating another link. Two full sentences with periods.
